name: The grand world (everything on, extra large)
description: Every optional feature at once, in a 512 x 512 world with sparse food: continents and seas, seasons with weather fronts and harsh and mild years, random ice ages, droughts and meteors, three kinds of plant that peak at different times of year, brains with memory, a sense of home and chemical signals, disease, camouflage, aging, litter size, fat and torpor genes, tolerance of relatives and sex as genes (everyone starts splitting in two), and cells that can bond into colonies with specialized cells. The first generation starts with some variety in the newer genes. Nothing here has been tuned or run for long, so treat it as an open experiment: watch the population chart for booms and busts, the Palate and Torpor trait charts, and the births-with-two-parents readout to see whether sex catches on.
